events.name: Bash
events.head: Survey patches, clones, docker state, pilot table
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; ls tantra-product-patches/ tantra-product-patches/*/; ls -d ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2 ~/tantra-feedback-work/* 2>&1; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo DOCKER_UP || echo DOCKER_DOWN; grep -n "Pilot" -A3 pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Read pilot table and check base commit
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan; sed -n 25,60p pipeline/agentic-dev-cycle.md; cd ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2 && git log --oneline -1 f0b901e && git status --short | head -5; head -20 /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2/fix_bug-1-*.patch | grep -E "^(From|Subject)"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Scratch clone at f0b901e and apply both patches
events.input: $ set -e; S=/tmp/t154-scratch; rm -rf $S; git clone -q ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2 $S; cd $S; git checkout -q -b scratch/t154-base f0b901e; P=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2; git -c user.name=t154 -c user.email=t154@local am -q $P/fix_red-suites--f0b901e.patch $P/ci_premerge-and-preview--f0b901e.patch; git log --oneline -3; cat scripts/preview.sh | head -80; cat docker-compose.preview.yml; ls -a | grep -i env

events.name: Bash
events.head: Apply patches and read scripts
events.input: $ set -e; S=/tmp/t154-scratch; cd $S; P=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/workshop-plan/tantra-product-patches/tantra-backend-v2; git apply $P/fix_red-suites--f0b901e.patch $P/ci_premerge-and-preview--f0b901e.patch; chmod +x scripts/*.sh; git add -A; git -c user.name=t154 -c user.email=t154@local commit -qm base; git status --short|head; cat scripts/preview.sh; cat docker-compose.preview.yml; cat scripts/premerge.sh; ls -a | grep -iE "env|docker"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check node_modules, env needs, Dockerfile
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t154-scratch; ls -d ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2/node_modules ~/tantra-feedback-work/tantra-backend-v2/node_modules 2>&1; ls ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2/.env* 2>&1 | sed 's/.*\///'; cat Dockerfile | head -40; grep -rn "MONGO\|DATABASE_URL\|mongoose.forRoot\|TypeOrmModule.forRoot" src/app.module.ts | head; grep -rln "Joi.object\|validationSchema" src | head -3; ls .env.example* 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect boot requirements
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t154-scratch; sed -n 30,80p src/app.module.ts; grep -rhoE "getOrThrow(<[a-z]+>)?\(\"[A-Z_]+\"" src | sort -u | head -40; grep -n "health\|setGlobalPrefix\|listen" src/main.ts

events.name: Bash
events.head: Link deps and look for other health routes
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t154-scratch; ln -s ~/Documents/GitHub/tantra-backend-v2/node_modules node_modules; grep -rn "'health'\|\"health\"" src --include=*.ts | grep -v spec | head; cat .dockerignore; grep -n node_modules .gitignore
